topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Lord above, what fresh trouble is this now? I heard tell from Markus, who often travels to the market town, that some lad or lass had the poor sense to have themselves scarred with the likes of the artist's work. Can you imagine such folly? That such skill, meant for paper and canvas, now adorns the hide of a fool, doomed to walk about showing the world such vanity. What’s worse, the artist, they say, is beside themselves, as if the gods themselves have turned their fields to dust. I dare not think on what this might mean for the village, with such a curse hanging heavy in the air. Pray for us, good folk, that this does not bring down the wrath of the saints upon our already burdened souls.
